summary_en: CKD Corporation authorized the acquisition of up to 1.3 million shares (1.94% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 5 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition period runs from the business day following the secondary offering settlement (occurring between October 27 and October 30, 2026) through December 30, 2026, aimed at improving capital efficiency, enhancing shareholder returns, and mitigating market supply-demand effects from the concurrent secondary offering.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decisions on Matters Pertaining to Acquisition of Own Shares (Acquisition of Own Shares Based on Articles of Incorporation Pursuant to Article 459, Paragraph 1 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief:
On October 7, 2026, CKD Corporation's Board of Directors authorized the acquisition of up to 1.3 million shares of its common stock, representing 1.94% of issued shares (excluding treasury stock), for a maximum aggregate purchase price of 5 billion yen. The shares will be acquired through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange beginning the business day after the secondary offering settlement date (expected between October 27 and October 30, 2026) and continuing through December 30, 2026.

The company stated two primary purposes for this buyback authorization. First, the acquisition is intended to improve capital efficiency and enhance shareholder returns through flexible treasury stock management. Second, the timing is coordinated with a concurrent secondary offering of the company's own shares announced on the same date. The buyback is designed to mitigate potential negative effects on market supply and demand that could arise from the offering.

As of September 30, 2026, CKD held 1.07 million shares as treasury stock, with 66.84 million shares issued and outstanding (excluding treasury stock). The actual execution of the authorized buyback remains subject to market conditions.
